Questions

Before you get in touch

How do you price a project?

After a short call we send a written scope with one fixed price. If the scope changes, we agree the change in writing before doing it. The starting prices on our services page are where most projects begin.

We are in the UK, US or the Gulf. Does the time difference matter?

We work with UK, US and Gulf hours and reply within one working day. You get a weekly update, and we can join calls in your morning or evening.

Can you work under our agency's name?

Yes. We take on white-label React and Next.js work for agencies who need extra hands. Your client deals with you; we deliver to you.

Do you build for mosques and Islamic schools?

Yes. We build bilingual Arabic and English sites with prayer times, events and donation links, and we take care with religious text and its sources, as in our Riyadh as-Saliheen app.

What happens after launch?

You can stay on a care plan from $30 a month for updates, fixes and hosting checks.

Have a project in mind?

Tell us what you need. We reply within one working day with questions and next steps.
